channel.title: IBM Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by IBM Corporation (ibm).

item.title: CVE-2026-3686 · 6.2 MEDIUM — Vulnerabilities exists in IBM Cloud Pak for Data System
item.description: IBM Cloud Pak for Data System 11.3.0.2 through Interim Fix 001 is vulnerable to a denial of service due to improper limitation of resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-3627 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Multiple Vulnerabilities in IBM Concert Software
item.description: IBM Concert 1.0.0 through 2.3.1 is vulnerable to SQL injection. A remote attacker could send specially crafted SQL statements, which could allow the attacker to view, add, modify, or delete information in the back-end database.
